methodology.assignmentRule: Seeded assignment of 162 palettes from the sample, then 35 user-flagged marks were reassigned to high-contrast palettes from that same sample; the giraffe is now also recolored.
methodology.recolorRule: Preserve dimensions and every alpha byte; map visible source luminance roles to the darker/lighter sampled colors.

visibilityRemediation.rule: Replace low-contrast assignments with high-contrast palettes from the 100-team sample; remove only edge-connected light-neutral pixels from fully opaque assets.
